items.en: The sync status now lists everything not updated from Canvas with the reason and when it was last updated, and shows sync errors separately with an error ID to report. Canvas values Semestra can't hold no longer stop the sync.
items.zh: 同步状态会列出没能从 Canvas 更新的内容，注明原因和上次更新的时间；同步出错单独列出，可复制错误编号反馈。Canvas 上超出 Semestra 范围的值不再导致同步出错。

items.en: Courses whose instructor hid the quizzes no longer show their assignments as failing to sync.
items.zh: 老师关闭了测验栏目的课程，作业同步不再显示失败。

items.en: A problem with one item no longer stops the rest of a course from syncing.
items.zh: 单项内容出错时，课程的其余内容照常同步。
